title: Every production CheckinComposer is built with no memory and no wearable, so Cura remembers nothing
method: AST read of both construction sites + live compose_morning with and without a memory
observed_at_discovery: CheckinComposer() is constructed bare at cura/__main__.py:159 (rehearse) and :239 (the daily run), and at cura_mcp_server.py:107, so memory=None and wearable_analyzer=None in every shipped path. _memory_touches() returns [] unconditionally and wearable_observations is always []. Observed live: with a memory holding an unreferenced event, compose_morning names it ('How did it go?'); with the composer as cura run actually builds it, the same event appears nowhere. The docstring on _memory_touches calls these 'the human touches that make Cura a companion'. Nothing the wearable sees — including a fall — reaches a check-in either. pytest exit 1, 2 failed.
